Interface Color

All Known Implementing Classes:
Color.Ansi, Color.Indexed, Color.Named, Color.Reset, Color.Rgb
public interface Color
Terminal colors supporting ANSI 16, 256-color indexed, and RGB true color modes.

      the ANSI code string (without CSI prefix or 'm' suffix), or empty string if not applicable

    • toAnsiBackground

      default String toAnsiBackground()

    • toAnsiUnderline

      default String toAnsiUnderline()
      Converts this color to an ANSI underline color code. Note that underline colors are only supported by some terminal emulators.
      Returns:
      the ANSI code string (without CSI prefix or 'm' suffix), or empty string if the color type doesn't support underline coloring

    • toRgb

      default Color.Rgb toRgb()
      Converts this color to RGB.

      ANSI and indexed colors are converted using standard terminal color palettes. Named colors delegate to their default value. Reset colors default to white.

      Returns:
      the RGB representation of this color

    • ansiToRgb

      static Color.Rgb ansiToRgb(AnsiColor ansi)
      Converts an ANSI color to RGB using standard terminal colors.
      Parameters:
      ansi - the ANSI color
      Returns:
      the RGB representation

    • indexedToRgb

      static Color.Rgb indexedToRgb(int index)
      Converts a 256-color indexed value to RGB.

      The 256-color palette is:

      • 0-15: Standard ANSI colors
      • 16-231: 6x6x6 color cube
      • 232-255: Grayscale ramp
      Parameters:
      index - the palette index (0-255)
      Returns:
      the RGB representation
